build: The same successful target-mask DLL/debug pair is reused. No code edits, rebuild or full reccmp rerun.
scope: Entry-reachable direct CFG correspondence under the listed exact-name/import/function-address identities. Ignore architectural no-ops and direct internal jump trampolines; preserve ordinary operations, registers, operand widths, prefixes and edge predicates, including paired inverse predicates. Shared/duplicated tails may correlate to the same instructions. This is structural evidence, not execution, callee/data-content equivalence, literal pointer-identity proof or a whole-game proof. Read-only C-string and declared DIALOG-token mappings compare complete contents through NUL, not storage identity, alias relationships or bytes beyond the terminator. Arbitrary PC/return-address inspection is outside this review. Calls are followed through normal returns only; exception/unwind/longjmp edges are not covered. Indirect jumps are refused. Unsupported operation, register, address and width differences remain unresolved. Raw scores and discovery differences are unchanged; current native/rebuilt ranges are pinned.

dialog_mode.current_state: The enum and dialog_impl case already exist. The public DLG_MODE spelling is absent; 47 raw mode-token uses were observed in seven card files. Naming that token is a possible source cleanup, not a missing runtime implementation.

dream_trawler.observation: The native static-effects reset block is itself unreachable. The entry into the shared comparisons is constrained to EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE (0x73) or EVENT_CLEANUP (0x22); the later test for EVENT_STATIC_EFFECTS (0x4700) cannot succeed. The current source contains the same impossible nested guard and its compiler removes that block. Do not enable that reset as a recovery fix. A source cleanup could flatten the event dispatch while preserving this native behavior.
